description: This file is a PHP unit test class for testing the LicenseDao component in the OrangeHRM system. It contains test cases for adding, editing, retrieving, deleting, and validating licenses within the system, utilizing test data fixtures and asserting expected behaviors.

classes.name: LicenseDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LicenseDao data access object in the OrangeHRM Admin module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating a LicenseDao instance and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testAddLicense
methods.description: Tests the creation and saving of a new License entity.

methods.name: testEditLicense
methods.description: Tests editing an existing License and saving the changes.

methods.name: testGetLicenseById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a License by its ID.

methods.name: testGetLicenseList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of License entities based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testDeleteLicenses
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple licenses and verifying the number of deletions.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests attempting to delete a non-existing license record.

methods.name: testIsExistingLicenseName
methods.description: Tests the existence check of license names with various case and whitespace variations.

methods.name: testGetLicenseByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a License entity by its name, with case and whitespace insensitivity.
